source.printedPageMap: PDF pp.2–129 map to printed pp.1–128; PDF p.1 is an unnumbered front cover and PDF p.130 is an unnumbered rear page. This bounded scope is printed pp.84–89 = PDF pp.85–90.

scope.scopeDescription: The revised Table III magic-item selector and all 21 referenced result tables shown on printed pp.84–89. Adjacent printed p.90/PDF91 is excluded from this row census.

method.granularity: A physical result band is one printed Dice row label, whether a single number or a range. A named result is one printed Result-label occurrence on that band; generic labels and multi-form descriptions are not split into extra outcomes. A value slot is one XP, GP sale, or scroll-level field per result band; ranges, slash-separated alternatives, unit qualifiers and superscript markers remain one cell.
method.verification: All six canonical PDF pages were rendered privately at 216 dpi with visible folios and visually reviewed one image per tool result. A focused p.84 crop distinguished dot, double-star and single-star marks; a focused p.89 H.2 crop verified variable-value markers and the scimitar qualifier. PDF text extraction was used only to find row baselines and cross-check counts; corrections were made against actual pixels. Full page images and text remain private. Reopened the full printed p.87/PDF p.88 image to verify the III.E.5 class-use legend beneath the table; added this separate block to the note count.
method.denominatorLimits: Source row and cell-type denominators are complete only for these six pages. Numeric cell contents were not transcribed or recomputed here; no all-book numeric-value verification is claimed. The original 36-unit UA transfer ledger and all other UA source units remain outside this task.
